Velvet Postcards That Feel as Good as They Look


Velvet postcards combine premium texture with understated elegance. The soft-touch lamination creates a velvety, ultra-matte surface that’s instantly striking to the hand and eye. Whether you’re promoting a product, inviting guests, or thanking clients, velvet postcards make a lasting impression with their rich texture and elevated design.

Postcards With Premium Tactile Appeal

Velvet Soft-Touch Lamination
Smooth Ultra-Matte Finish
Lasting Durability and Detail
Coated with suede-like texture Anti-glare and anti-smudge Printed on 16 pt. cardstock, 19 pt. after lamination
Instant premium feel Elevates minimalist designs Withstands frequent handling
Enhances brand perception Perfect for modern messaging Great for mailers and handouts

Built for Beauty and Built to Last




Printed on Thick 16 pt. Cardstock (19 pt. with Lamination)

Velvet lamination adds extra thickness and soft texture to every card.

Spot UV Available

Highlight logos, names, or calls to action with glossy accents.

Sizes Ranging From 4" x 6" to 6" x 11"

Choose a size that fits your message — from standard to oversized formats.

Front-Only or Double-Sided Printing

Maximize space or keep it clean with flexible layout options.

Rounded Corners Optional

Add a polished, contemporary finish to your postcard edges.



Velvet Postcards FAQs

Q: What makes velvet postcards different from regular matte postcards?

Velvet postcards use a soft-touch laminate that creates a rich, suede-like texture. They’re thicker and more tactile than standard matte finishes.

Q: Can I write on velvet postcards?

The laminated surface may not be suitable for all pens. We recommend testing or requesting a sample before handwriting on them.

Q: How soon can I receive my velvet postcards?

To find out how soon you can receive the order, go to “Estimate Shipping & Delivery” below the online calculator and input your ZIP code. The estimated arrival dates will appear based on your selections and location.
